title: Joy to the World
lyrics_original: Joy to the World, the Lord is come!
Let earth receive her King;
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And Heaven and nature sing,
And Heaven and nature sing,
And Heaven, and Heaven, and nature sing
Joy to the earth, the Savior reigns!
Let men their songs employ;
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat, the sounding joy.
No more let sins and sorrows grow
Nor thorns infest the ground
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found
Far as the curse is found
Far as, far as the curse is found
He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His righteousness,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders, wonders, of His love.

bible_verses.telugu: సర్వభూజనులారా, యెహోవానుబట్టి ఉత్సహించుడి ఆర్భాటముతో సంతోషగానము చేయుడి కీర్తనలు పాడుడి.
bible_verses.english: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా వేంచేయుచున్నాడు ఆకాశము సంతోషించునుగాక భూమి ఆనందించును  గాక సముద్రమును దాని సంపూర్ణతయు ఘోషించునుగాక. పొలమును దానియందుగల సర్వమును యెహోవా సన్నిధిని ప్రహర్షించునుగాక. వనవృక్షములన్నియు ఉత్సాహధ్వని చేయునుగాక.
bible_verses.english: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it. Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే ఆ దూతభయ  పడకుడి; ఇదిగో ప్రజలందరికిని కలుగబోవు మహా సంతోషకరమైన సువర్తమానము నేను మీకు తెలియజేయు చున్నాను;
bible_verses.english: But the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people."

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming into our world and bringing real, lasting joy. Forgive me for the times I let busyness crowd You out, and help me prepare room for You in my heart today. Let my life echo the worship of all creation as I celebrate Your reigning grace and truth. Fill me with Your peace so that others might see Your joy shining through me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming into our world and bringing real, lasting joy. Forgive me for the times I let busyness crowd You out, and help me prepare room for You in my heart today. Let my life echo the worship of all creation as I celebrate Your reigning grace and truth. devotional.reflection_english: "Joy to the World" invites us to celebrate the grand arrival of Jesus, our true King who brings redemption to every corner of creation. As earth and heaven burst into praise, this timeless hymn gently asks us to clear away life's distractions and prepare room in our hearts for Him. True joy isn't found in perfect circumstances, but in welcoming the Savior who reigns with grace and truth. Today, let your heart join all of creation in singing of the great news that changes everything: our Lord has come.
